references.text: See, the Lord has proclaimed to the ends of the earth: Say to Daughter Zion, 'See, your salvation comes.' See, his reward is with him, and his recompense goes before him.
See, the Lord God comes with power, and his arm rules for him. See, his reward is with him, and his recompense goes before him.
See, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay each person according to what they have done.
